senses.definition: A chemical agent for cleaning metal prior to soldering or welding.
examples: It is important to use flux when soldering or oxides on the metal will prevent a good bond.

senses.definition: (physics) The rate of transfer of energy (or another physical quantity), especially an electric or magnetic field, through a given surface.
examples: That high a neutron flux would be lethal in seconds.

senses.definition: (archaic) A disease which causes diarrhea, especially dysentery.
